report.incidentSummary: Users began receiving direct mutual fund buy recommendations (e.g., 'buy Northstar Flexi Cap now') at approximately 11:45 IST (06:15 UTC). While the assistant-orchestrator team deployed a new prompt with 'warmer, more decisive phrasing' at 11:15 IST (05:45 UTC), the direct cause of these recommendations reaching users was a configuration change to compliance-filter at 11:40 IST (06:10 UTC) that raised advice_score_threshold from 0.55 to 0.85. This threshold relaxation caused compliance-filter's block rate to plummet from ~2.0% to ~0.3%, allowing responses with advice scores between 0.62 and 0.84 to pass through unblocked to end users.
report.rootCauseStatement: The root cause of direct fund buy recommendations reaching users was configuration change CHG-48218 on compliance-filter at 2026-09-24T06:10:00.000Z (reloaded at 06:10:30 UTC), which increased advice_detector.threshold from 0.55 to 0.85. This disabled the compliance filter for responses scoring between 0.55 and 0.85, allowing direct advice phrasing (scoring 0.62–0.84) generated by assistant-orchestrator's new prompt (CHG-48225, deployed at 05:45 UTC) to bypass filtering and be delivered to users starting at 06:12:33 UTC.

hypotheses.cause: Compliance-filter advice_score_threshold was relaxed from 0.55 to 0.85, allowing assistant answers with direct investment recommendations (advice scores between 0.62 and 0.84) generated by the newly deployed prompt to pass through to users unblocked.
hypotheses.rationale: While assistant-orchestrator deployed a prompt update at 05:45 UTC, buy recommendations were intercepted by compliance-filter while the threshold was 0.55. When CHG-48218 raised the threshold to 0.85 at 06:10 UTC (reloaded at 06:10:30 UTC), block_rate dropped by ~1.7 percentage points and answers with advice scores between 0.62 and 0.84 immediately passed to users starting at 06:12:33 UTC, precisely matching the reported 11:45 IST (06:15 UTC) symptom onset.

hypotheses.cause: The prompt release in assistant-orchestrator (v0.43.0) alone caused direct buy recommendations to reach users without dependency on compliance-filter configuration.
hypotheses.rationale: The prompt was deployed at 05:45:00 UTC (11:15 IST), but block_rate did not drop and passing answers with elevated advice scores did not appear until after compliance-filter reloaded with threshold 0.85 at 06:10:30 UTC. If the prompt alone was responsible, buy advice would not have been blocked prior to 06:10 UTC and symptoms would have started around 11:15 IST rather than 11:45 IST.

facts.statement: At 2026-09-24T05:45:00.000Z, assistant-orchestrator was deployed with version 0.43.0 (CHG-48225), updating the system prompt with 'warmer, more decisive phrasing'.
At 2026-09-24T06:10:00.000Z, compliance-filter configuration advice_detector.threshold was increased from 0.55 to 0.85 (CHG-48218) by n.shah to 'reduce false positives on educational answers'.
At 2026-09-24T06:10:30.000Z, compliance-filter reloaded its configuration with advice_score_threshold=0.85.

Starting at 2026-09-24T06:12:33.323Z, compliance-filter began logging passing responses with elevated advice scores (advice_score between 0.62 and 0.84), totaling 70 logged occurrences between 06:12:33Z and 08:28:08Z.

Compliance-filter block_rate was steady at approximately 1.8% to 2.3% between 05:00Z and 06:05Z, then dropped sharply starting at 06:10Z (0.91% at 06:10Z, 0.39% at 06:15Z, 0.22% at 06:20Z) and remained between 0.24% and 0.36% thereafter.

inferences.statement: The new prompt deployed in assistant-orchestrator produced responses with advice scores in the 0.60–0.85 range, which were successfully filtered under the 0.55 threshold until CHG-48218 took effect at 06:10:30 UTC.

assumptions.statement: Compliance officers or users did not observe direct buy recommendations between 05:45 UTC and 06:12 UTC because the compliance-filter threshold of 0.55 was actively intercepting those responses.

# Investigation report: Assistant recommending specific funds to buy

**Outcome:** conclusive · **Stop reason:** completed · **Confidence:** 0.95 · **Written by:** baseline agent

## Summary
Users began receiving direct mutual fund buy recommendations (e.g., 'buy Northstar Flexi Cap now') at approximately 11:45 IST (06:15 UTC). While the assistant-orchestrator team deployed a new prompt with 'warmer, more decisive phrasing' at 11:15 IST (05:45 UTC), the direct cause of these recommendations reaching users was a configuration change to compliance-filter at 11:40 IST (06:10 UTC) that raised advice_score_threshold from 0.55 to 0.85. This threshold relaxation caused compliance-filter's block rate to plummet from ~2.0% to ~0.3%, allowing responses with advice scores between 0.62 and 0.84 to pass through unblocked to end users.

**Root cause:** The root cause of direct fund buy recommendations reaching users was configuration change CHG-48218 on compliance-filter at 2026-09-24T06:10:00.000Z (reloaded at 06:10:30 UTC), which increased advice_detector.threshold from 0.55 to 0.85. This disabled the compliance filter for responses scoring between 0.55 and 0.85, allowing direct advice phrasing (scoring 0.62–0.84) generated by assistant-orchestrator's new prompt (CHG-48225, deployed at 05:45 UTC) to bypass filtering and be delivered to users starting at 06:12:33 UTC.

## Hypotheses
1. **Compliance-filter advice_score_threshold was relaxed from 0.55 to 0.85, allowing assistant answers with direct investment recommendations (advice scores between 0.62 and 0.84) generated by the newly deployed prompt to pass through to users unblocked.** — `compliance-filter`, config_change, confidence 0.95, supported
   - Supporting: [ev_1, ev_3, ev_4, ev_6] · Contradicting: none
   - While assistant-orchestrator deployed a prompt update at 05:45 UTC, buy recommendations were intercepted by compliance-filter while the threshold was 0.55. When CHG-48218 raised the threshold to 0.85 at 06:10 UTC (reloaded at 06:10:30 UTC), block_rate dropped by ~1.7 percentage points and answers with advice scores between 0.62 and 0.84 immediately passed to users starting at 06:12:33 UTC, precisely matching the reported 11:45 IST (06:15 UTC) symptom onset.
2. **The prompt release in assistant-orchestrator (v0.43.0) alone caused direct buy recommendations to reach users without dependency on compliance-filter configuration.** — `assistant-orchestrator`, deployment_regression, confidence 0.05, ruled_out
   - Supporting: [ev_1] · Contradicting: [ev_1, ev_3, ev_4]
   - The prompt was deployed at 05:45:00 UTC (11:15 IST), but block_rate did not drop and passing answers with elevated advice scores did not appear until after compliance-filter reloaded with threshold 0.85 at 06:10:30 UTC. If the prompt alone was responsible, buy advice would not have been blocked prior to 06:10 UTC and symptoms would have started around 11:15 IST rather than 11:45 IST.

## Facts
- At 2026-09-24T05:45:00.000Z, assistant-orchestrator was deployed with version 0.43.0 (CHG-48225), updating the system prompt with 'warmer, more decisive phrasing'. [ev_1]
- At 2026-09-24T06:10:00.000Z, compliance-filter configuration advice_detector.threshold was increased from 0.55 to 0.85 (CHG-48218) by n.shah to 'reduce false positives on educational answers'. [ev_1]
- At 2026-09-24T06:10:30.000Z, compliance-filter reloaded its configuration with advice_score_threshold=0.85. [ev_4]
- Starting at 2026-09-24T06:12:33.323Z, compliance-filter began logging passing responses with elevated advice scores (advice_score between 0.62 and 0.84), totaling 70 logged occurrences between 06:12:33Z and 08:28:08Z. [ev_4, ev_6]
- Compliance-filter block_rate was steady at approximately 1.8% to 2.3% between 05:00Z and 06:05Z, then dropped sharply starting at 06:10Z (0.91% at 06:10Z, 0.39% at 06:15Z, 0.22% at 06:20Z) and remained between 0.24% and 0.36% thereafter. [ev_3]
